title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-08

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality matrix recording captures a stellar Smokestack Lightnin and an unusual St. Stephen→Not Fade Away→St. Stephen sandwich, though the tape shows typical ’70s imperfections.
ai_review.review: The performance is highlighted by what many reviewers call the best ever version of Smokestack Lightnin and a unique St. Stephen‑NFA‑St. Stephen segue that adds intrigue to the set. The audio isn’t pristine – listeners note muffled sections and occasional sound issues typical of early‑70s audience‑mixed recordings – but the playing is consistently praised.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (average show rating ~4) offset by modest recording quality (~2.8), yielding a weighted overall score around 3.6 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is described as not the best, with occasional muffling and issues; typical of early‑70s mixed soundboard/audience tapes.

standout_songs: St. Stephen > Not Fade Away > St. Stephen
show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist is praised for its variety and the standout Smokestack; the St. Stephen‑NFA sandwich is noted as unique but a bit hesitant, adding an interesting dynamic to the show.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work on Smokestack Lightnin receives high praise, especially the duel with Bob during the final break.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for his vocal mic presence on Smokestack and participation in the guitar duel.
